query: INSERT INTO org_recovery_escrows (org_id, account_id, key_version, escrow, escrow_signature, sealed_key, created_at) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7) ON CONFLICT (org_id, account_id) DO UPDATE SET key_version = excluded.key_version, escrow = excluded.escrow, escrow_signature = excluded.escrow_signature, sealed_key = excluded.sealed_key, created_at = excluded.created_at
